error[ZBX-E0425]: overlayfs can't be mounted for this container
  while  starting container web-1
  cause  mounting the overlay filesystem of the tree failed: operation not
         permitted (EPERM)
  cause  overlayfs needs Linux 5.11 or newer with the overlay module, and an
         upper layer on a file system that keeps user.* extended attributes
  name   web-1
  rootfs /home/alice/.local/state/zbx/containers/web-1/merged
  step   mount_overlay (12 of 49)
  fix    look for the policy that denies it:   sudo dmesg | grep -iE 'apparmor|seccomp|selinux|userns'
         see what this host allows:            zbx doctor
         or run a directory instead:           zbx run --rootfs ./alpine -- sh
  more   zbx explain E0425
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0425.html
